definitions.explanation: Having no employment or occupation. Used on official forms and in news reporting to describe a person's employment status.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧、{無職|むしょく}です。
{無職|むしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.notes: In Japanese news, suspects are often identified by occupation or {無職|むしょく}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}めて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧{無職|むしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: It has been six months of unemployment since I quit the company.

notes:
USAGE:
A neutral, factual term for being unemployed. On official forms, {無職|むしょく} is the standard entry for the occupation field when one has no job. In news reports, suspects are commonly described as {無職|むしょく} when they have no occupation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無職|むしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧/⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧: unemployed man/woman
- {無職|むしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: state of unemployment
- ⟦{職業|しょくぎょう}→職業：03245_shokugyou⟧：{無職|むしょく}: occupation: none
